title: Filter salesman commission evidence and summaries by employee name
description: Users find a salesman by a literal employee-name keyword in the existing designer without knowing an employee ID. Extend existing SalesCommissionFilterDto with optional trimmed keyword, blank=absent, max80 characters; reject controls/oversize before source reads. Reuse one normalization rule for service/catalog/preview/current-page Excel/PDF/all-match summary Excel/PDF. Intersect current customer scope and existing customer/salesman/currency/date/status filters before Take(501) using an EF-translatable correlated nondeleted BaseEmployees.Any predicate for persisted SalesmanId and literal EmployeeName.Contains; no broad employee directory or extra N+1 query. Percent/underscore are literal text, no SQL wildcards; follows current provider collation, do not promise case-insensitive behavior. Nonblank keyword excludes unassigned/missing/deleted employee names; omitted keyword preserves existing explicit unassigned/unknown buckets. Catalog describes capability, preview and every download keep normalized keyword context even employee columns hidden; UI resets page on change and preserves state for downloads/errors, escapes context. Check in-memory service/API/UI/downloads and offline SQL Server ToQueryString translation where feasible without connection; unavailable real provider acceptance remains environment-blocked. Development only. Reuse existing sales-commission menu, current-user SalespersonDataScopeService customer scope, approved nondeleted SalesOrders, <=366-day inclusive date window and fail-closed 500-order source cap, and OperationLogMiddleware HTTP audit. Each endpoint validates its current request and rechecks identity/menu/fresh scope; invalid input, revoked authorization or overflow returns no data/file. Employee identity is an order attribute, not a permission boundary. Known original-currency signed order amounts remain separate; invalid raw currencies are distinct count-only unknown-amount groups. Historical Profit, ProfitRate and CommissionAmount remain null with reasons, including configured zero current reference rate; current SalesCommissionRate is not a historical agreement, earned payout, customer agency fee or ledger posting. No client identity/scope/rows/aggregates as authority, arbitrary/model-generated SQL, business writes, new domain entities or persistence schema, migrations, schema/view/stored-procedure changes, production SQL or real database execution, credentials/secrets/.env/config changes, irreversible operations, production deployment or real browser acceptance. Preserve unrelated modules and uncommitted work. Run focused in-memory service/API/export/UI source-contract tests plus configured safe Release build/test; unavailable external database/browser acceptance is environment-blocked, never fabricated passed.
acceptance_criteria: Validated optional literal name keyword intersects authorized source before the cap using bounded correlated employee predicates, preserving blank defaults and rejecting invalid requests without directory leaks.
Catalog/preview/designer and all current-page/summary Excel/PDF downloads preserve the same normalized safe keyword context and page-reset/error state.

Tests cover invalid/blank keywords, scope revocation, unknown/unassigned/deleted employees, literal metacharacters, filtering before caps and all download contexts; offline SQL translation where feasible and safe build/test passes.
